_about: The islands' main quest (core/quest_state.gd decides, game/quest_things.gd shows its things). Every word the player reads is in data/zombies/writing/quest.txt, one [step <id>] section per step here. Steps run in order; the whole party shares one quest and the host decides; game over starts it again from the first step. A step's kind says what finishes it: use = interact at its spot (island + [x, z] from that island's middle); power = the islands' power is on; kills = `count` enemies die within `radius` metres of its spot; shoot = every lamp in `spots` is shot (each [x, z] from its island's middle and `height` metres up a post); build = the buildable `thing` (data/buildables.json) is built; reforge = the Re-forge is awake (data/reforge_quest.json; already awake = passed at once); boss = the enemy `enemy` (data/enemies.json) comes out of the sea at its spot, as strong as an island boss `rounds_ahead` rounds after the round being fought, and dies. reward: `unique` = a hand-made unique of data/gun_uniques.json for every player on the islands ("any" = a random one), `points` to everybody there. reach = metres to a `use` spot. A use step with `deck` stands on that treetop / offshore deck (data/treetops.json): its `at` is then world-plan metres (the islands' frame) and the deck's height counts; `look_at` = an island the thing there turns to when used; `forge`: true = the spot is the Re-forge (it must be awake, with power). A step already true when it comes (power on, Re-forge awake) is passed at once. Polish1 D4f: the things are tools/blender/quest_main.py models (game/quest_things.gd).
